title: Transportation Inspectors
description: Inspect equipment or goods in connection with the safe transport of cargo or people. Includes rail transportation inspectors, such as freight inspectors, rail inspectors, and other inspectors of transportation vehicles not elsewhere classified.

tasks.text: Prepare and submit reports after completion of freight shipments.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log delivery details into structured records

dwas.name: Record details of deliveries or shipments.

tasks.text: Inspect shipments to ensure that freight is securely braced and blocked.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cargo securing inspection is hands-on physical verification

dwas.name: Inspect cargo to ensure it is properly loaded or secured.

tasks.text: Record details about freight conditions, handling of freight, and any problems encountered.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Advise crews in techniques of stowing dangerous and heavy cargo.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Observe loading of freight to ensure that crews comply with procedures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Loading oversight is physical, in-the-world supervision

dwas.name: Monitor loading processes to ensure they are performed properly.

tasks.text: Recommend remedial procedures to correct any violations found during inspections.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Proposes corrective procedures; human verifies applicability

dwas.name: Recommend changes or corrective procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Inspect loaded cargo, cargo lashed to decks or in storage facilities, and cargo handling devices to determine compliance with health and safety regulations and need for maintenance.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cargo securing inspection is hands-on physical verification

dwas.name: Inspect cargo to ensure it is properly loaded or secured.

tasks.text: Notify workers of any special treatment required for shipments.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Vehicle movement coordination is real-time physical

dwas.name: Communicate with others to coordinate vehicle movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Direct crews to reload freight or to insert additional bracing or packing as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Material handling direction is on-floor supervision

dwas.name: Direct material handling or moving activities.

tasks.text: Check temperatures and humidities of shipping and storage areas to ensure that they are at appropriate levels to protect cargo.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Monitoring cargo conditions is physical/sensor-based

tasks.text: Determine cargo transportation capabilities by reading documents that set forth cargo loading and securing procedures, capacities, and stability factors.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse work orders into procedures reliably

dwas.name: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.

tasks.text: Read draft markings to determine depths of vessels in water.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on depth/level measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure the level or depth of water or other liquids.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Post warning signs on vehicles containing explosives or flammable or radioactive materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically marking objects requires manipulation

dwas.name: Mark materials or objects for identification.

tasks.text: Measure heights and widths of loads to ensure they will pass over bridges or through tunnels on scheduled routes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of material

dwas.name: Measure product or material dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Calculate gross and net tonnage, hold capacities, volumes of stored fuel and water, cargo weights, and vessel stability factors, using mathematical formulas.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Weight/volume calculations from given data

dwas.name: Calculate weights, volumes or other characteristics of materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Measure vessels' holds and depths of fuel and water in tanks, using sounding lines and tape measures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on depth/level measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure the level or depth of water or other liquids.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Visually inspect cargo for damage upon arrival or discharge.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Property condition assessment requires physical presence

dwas.name: Examine condition of property or products.
